entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_00
entries.text: Ugh! How could I LOSE?! What the HECK![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_system_01
entries.text: About a year and a half ago...

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_01
entries.text: Arrrghhh! What the HECK!!![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_honooboss_01
entries.text: Your toy car didn’t budge an inch, huh.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_02
entries.text: I told you—it’s not a toy! It’s called the\nStarmobile, and I was up all night building it![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_akuboss_01
entries.text: The problem’s clearly that we’re not givin’ it\nenough juice.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_akuboss_02
entries.text: You designed this thing to be powered by two\nCharcadet, but it’s just too heavy.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_kakutouboss_01
entries.text: That’s such a shame... I wanted to see the looks\non our bullies’ faces once we got it moving.[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_03
entries.text: I’m sorry... I really thought it would work...[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_dokuboss_01
entries.text: Come, good fellow. ’Tis no occasion for\nmelancholy.[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_dokuboss_02
entries.text: Why, to make such a remarkable contraption by\nthine own hand... Genius, thy name is Ortega![VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_04
entries.text: Yeah, well...there’s no point if it doesn’t work,\nis there?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_05
entries.text: If I knew all that effort would have zero payout,\nI’d have just asked Mother to buy a car for us...[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_honooboss_02
entries.text: See, this is why people don’t take you seriously.\nYou say some stupid things, you know that?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_akuboss_03
entries.text: Mela! Cool it, would ya?[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_honooboss_03
entries.text: Yeah, how ’bout no.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_honooboss_04
entries.text:
I mean, we even put this in the code, for cryin’
out loud!\c
When we started Team Star, we swore to quit
relyin’ on our parents or bags of cash to fix our
problems for us. Or did you forget?[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_honooboss_05
entries.text: If that hunka junk doesn’t move, get it moving.\c\nIf we’re short on juice, just gotta crank up the\npower somehow. Doesn’t take a genius, man.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_kakutouboss_02
entries.text: That’s easy enough to say, Mellie. Do you have\nan actual plan?[VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_honooboss_06
entries.text: Yup. I’m gonna train up my Charcadet and have\n’em evolve. Their boosted firepower will get the\r\nStarmobile moving, no sweat.[VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_dokuboss_03
entries.text: But the hour of Operation Star is nigh at hand...\nWill you succeed in time?[VAR 0x0114(0023)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_honooboss_07
entries.text: Oh, I’ll get it done![VAR 0x0114(001F)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_kakutouboss_03
entries.text: Mellie, wait![VAR 0x0114(0022)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_akuboss_04
entries.text: You know, Mela shoots her mouth off an awful\nlot, but she means well.[VAR 0x0114(0021)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_10
entries.text: Guh. This sucks...[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_11
entries.text: This sucks! I hate myself for losing, but I also can’t\nget over how awesome you were in that battle![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_12
entries.text: If any of us squad bosses are defeated, that\nmeans we have to step down. And going against\r\nour code would make me a traitor to the team...[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_13
entries.text: Gah, FINE! Not like I have a choice anyway, so\ntake the badge already! You’d better treat it with\r\nthe respect it deserves![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_waza_01
entries.text: I’m not done yet... Here’s my favorite TM, too.\nFeel free to marvel at how awesome it is.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_14
entries.text: And just so you know? You are the WORST!\nLike, the most annoying person EVER![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_15
entries.text: But I get it—you’re super strong. I’ll admit that\nmuch! You even busted up my Starmobile![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_01
entries.text: Young Master Ortega...[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_16
entries.text: Mr. Harrington![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_17
entries.text: I guess it’s time for my piano lesson, huh?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_18
entries.text: As it happens, I just lost my boss title, so I’m all\ngood to head on home...[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_02
entries.text: Ah, actually, a different matter brought me.\nThere’s somebody I would like you to meet.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_19
entries.text: [EMPTY 85]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_03
entries.text: [EMPTY 85]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_20
entries.text: [EMPTY 85]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_04
entries.text: [EMPTY 85]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_05
entries.text: He’s a...distant acquaintance of mine.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_21
entries.text: [EMPTY 85]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_06
entries.text: [EMPTY 85]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_01
entries.text: The name’s Clive.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_22
entries.text: Okaaay... What’s your business here?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_02
entries.text:
I want you to tell me something.\c
You’re the son of a wealthy family and heir to a
major apparel company. So why join a group like
Team Star?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_23
entries.text: What a question to ask someone you’ve just met.\c\nWell, my answer’s the same as everyone else in\nthe team... It’s ’cause I was being bullied.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_03
entries.text: So the academy really did use to have an issue\nwith bullying...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_24
entries.text: Who would guess, right? The school is all\nrainbows and butterflies these days.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_25
entries.text: And the bullies from back then don’t even go to\nthe academy anymore.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_04
entries.text: Why? What happened to them?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_07
entries.text: As the former director of the academy, I believe\nI am best positioned to answer that question.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_26
entries.text: Mr. Harrington...[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_08
entries.text: About 18 months ago, the members of Team Star\nconfronted the students who used to bully them,\r\nand an altercation broke out between the groups.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_09
entries.text: Though it did not escalate into a major incident,\nthe altercation nonetheless caused a scandal of\r\nhitherto unknown proportions.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_10
entries.text: As a result of what occurred that day, the\nstudents who had perpetrated the bullying\r\ndropped out of the academy, one after another.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_05
entries.text: But...but there aren’t any records of that\nanywhere in the academy![VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_11
entries.text: No, I should imagine not. My former deputy\ndeleted all records of the incident, you see.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_06
entries.text: What?! Why would anyone do that?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_12
entries.text: Just as I was puzzling over how best to deal with\nTeam Star in the aftermath of the incident, a\r\ncertain student came to see me.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_13
entries.text: This student declared that they would take all\nresponsibility for the team’s actions.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_14
entries.text: In exchange, they requested that I exonerate the\nother students of Team Star from any blame.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_27
entries.text: HUH?! No...no one told me that![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_15
entries.text: I accepted the request and agreed not to take\ndisciplinary action against Team Star.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_16
entries.text: Then, I assigned 18 months of overseas study to\nthe student who took responsibility for the team.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_07
entries.text: A year and a half of studying abroad...?[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_17
entries.text: This was not intended as a punishment, you\nunderstand. Team Star were the victims, after all.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_18
entries.text: I wanted this student to take some time to rest,\nso I had them return home to the Galar region\r\nunder the pretext of “overseas study.”[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_19
entries.text:
Around that time, however, the former deputy
director took it upon himself to erase all traces
of the incident from the academy’s servers.\c
It appears his intent was to shield himself from
any blame.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_08
entries.text: So he tried to cover up the whole thing?\nThat’s terrible![VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_20
entries.text: After we discovered what he had done, I dealt\nwith him appropriately, of course.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_21
entries.text: But the inability of myself and the rest of the\nteaching staff to prevent this terrible act also\r\nrepresented a grave blunder on our part.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_24
entries.text:
I accepted the blame that lay at my feet and
resigned from my position as director.\c
The rest of the teaching staff then joined me in
handing in their notices.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_09
entries.text: So that’s why the current teachers were all\nbrought in a year and a half ago...[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_22
entries.text: I understand my actions have caused you a great\ndeal of trouble. You have my sincere apologies.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_28
entries.text: Hang on, Mr. Harrington! How come you\nsuddenly decided to talk about this now?![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_jentle_23
entries.text: Young Master Ortega... Team Star cannot carry\non in its current fashion. I merely wish to give you\r\na chance to chart a better course.[VAR 0x0114(003C)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_29
entries.text: Well, there’s no way I’m abandoning my friends\nand going to school without them. Not after\r\nwe’ve come this far![VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_nelke_10
entries.text: Your friends in Team Star must mean a great deal\nto you.[VAR 0x0114(001E)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_30
entries.text: Isn’t that obvious?[VAR 0x0114(0020)]

entries.label: ajito_fairy_040_fairyboss_31
entries.text: It’s ’cause, you know...they’re my greatest\ntreasure in the whole world.[VAR 0x0114(0020)]
